title: A Short Checklist
contentHTML:
A calm reading surface gives the words enough room to establish their own rhythm without adding another layer of interface.

Before the release:

  • Write the release notes
  • Check every platform's markup, including the ones that send long items that wrap onto a second line
  • Tag the release

A calm reading surface gives the words enough room to establish their own rhythm without adding another layer of interface.

  • Rebuild the zip
  • Install it on the phone
